description: Global security dashboard showing anomaly activity, alert activity, pipeline metrics, risk cards, top anomaly types, top triggered rules, and overview summaries.

elements.label: Refresh Overview
elements.description: Button that refreshes all overview metrics and page data.
exampleUserQuestions: where to click here to refresh overview data
show me the refresh button on overview
highlight the refresh button on overview

elements.label: Total Events KPI
elements.description: Shows the total number of events processed today.
exampleUserQuestions: where should i look here to see the total events processed today

elements.label: Active Users KPI
elements.description: Shows active application users for today and the current period with trend indicators.

elements.label: Anomaly Rate KPI
elements.description: Shows the current anomaly detection rate.

elements.label: Critical Alerts KPI
elements.description: Shows the count of recent critical alerts requiring immediate attention.
exampleUserQuestions: where should i look to see critical alerts

elements.label: High Risk Alerts KPI
elements.description: Shows the count of high risk alerts.

elements.label: Average Risk KPI
elements.description: Shows the average anomaly/risk score for today or recent events across all alerts.

elements.label: Predicted Anomaly Rate KPI
elements.description: Shows the predicted anomaly rate from the Ridge forecast model.

elements.label: Predicted Events KPI
elements.description: Shows the predicted total events from the XGBoost forecast model.
exampleUserQuestions: highlight the card that indicates the tomorrow predicted total events

elements.label: Expected Alert Volume KPI
elements.description: Shows the expected alert volume from the forecast model.

elements.label: Top Anomaly Types
elements.description: Chart showing top anomaly types detected ranked by frequency.

elements.label: Top Triggered Rules
elements.description: Chart showing top triggered rules ranked by frequency.

elements.label: Model Health Overview
elements.description: Panel showing the health status of ML models in the overview page.

elements.label: Field Coverage
elements.description: Panel showing field coverage metrics including sequence coverage, unknown ratios, missing features, and defaulted features.

elements.label: Session Finalization Summary
elements.description: Panel showing open sessions, explicitly finalized, and timeout finalized session counts.

elements.label: Recent Critical Alerts Table
elements.description: Table showing the most recent critical alerts with risk level, event ID, insured ID, anomaly type, risk score, timestamp, and investigate actions.
exampleUserQuestions: where are the recent critical alerts

elements.label: Live Connection Badge
elements.description: Badge showing the SSE live connection status for real-time updates.

elements.label: Data Source Chip
elements.description: Chip showing the data source for the overview data.
exampleUserQuestions: where is the data coming from
